svg.title: Daniel Martinez — Human Resources Business Partner

text.tspan: People-focused HR partner with 8 years of experience supporting
growing teams. Trusted advisor to managers on employee relations,
talent development and practical people strategies.
• Partner with 12 managers to support a team of 250 employees.
• Redesigned onboarding, improving new-hire satisfaction by 24%.
• Built manager training on feedback, coaching and career growth.
• Supported recruitment, employee relations and HR operations.
• Introduced quarterly engagement surveys and team action plans.
